title: Admin Web V2 Library Management And Localization
problem: Admin Web V2 has a clean read-only Media Libraries route, but it cannot yet manage a library, inspect source/profile readiness, run safe library actions, or support localized UI copy.

cd apps/admin-web && npm run check && npm run test -- App.test.tsx adminApi/client.test.ts adminApi/dataSource.test.ts
cd apps/admin-web && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build

evidence.summary: Opened workstream docs and task ledger from the Admin Web V2 media-library parity audit.

Implemented route-owned /libraries/:libraryId detail with system-config plus metadata-profile data-source composition, safe fallback states, source/scan/NFO readiness placeholders, and redaction tests.
Added dependency-free Admin Web i18n foundation with English and Simplified Chinese catalogs, shell locale selector, localized SourceLabel text, and library management message-id coverage.
Implemented Metadata Profile full-replacement editing, safe public-read Source inventory bridge summaries, and confirmed Admin API scan/NFO command wrappers returning redaction-safe job summaries.

Re-scored remaining Admin Web V2 parity gaps and split follow-on lane candidates for media browsing/item detail, settings/network mutation authority, users/library access, governance repair actions, Addon operations mutations, playback support detail, and i18n expansion.
Closed the lane after fresh Admin Web, Rust, browser, review, and whitespace gates; handed off to admin-web-v2-media-browsing-and-item-detail-governance.

continue_policy.notes: Open admin-web-v2-media-browsing-and-item-detail-governance as the recommended next Admin Web V2 follow-on before implementing media browsing or item detail work.
